findings: CI-perf change: the Test workflow re-ran the full ~6k-test suite up to 4x (3-version matrix each with coverage instrumentation + a separate `coverage` job re-running the whole suite) serially with no pip cache and no workflow-level concurrency. Measured a clean run at ~9m20s wall-clock with frequent 17-27m cancelled-run pileups. This PR parallelizes + dedups without weakening any gate.

Change set (4 functional files + this evidence): (1) pyproject [dev] += pytest-xdist; (2) test matrix runs `-n auto`, drops `-v`, runs coverage instrumentation only on the 3.13 leg (3.11/3.12 functional-only) -- the 3.13 leg stages combined `.coverage` as `coverage.data` and uploads it + `coverage.xml`; (3) the `coverage` required-check becomes a fail-closed sentinel (needs:[event-gate,test] + always(); fails closed if the test matrix did not succeed or the artifact is missing) that runs `coverage report --fail-under=85` on the consumed artifact with NO suite rerun; (4) top-level concurrency supersedes stale in-progress runs per ref; (5) pip caching on setup-python; (6) determinism fix in tests/test_workflow_state_machine.py.

Determinism fix (xdist prerequisite): TestValidateTransitionMatrix.test_allowed_transitions parametrized over a frozenset (`for n in allowed`); frozenset iteration is PYTHONHASHSEED-dependent so xdist worker processes collected a different parametrize order -> 'Different tests were collected between gw*' collection abort. Fixed with `sorted(allowed)` (the correct collection-determinism fix, NOT a PYTHONHASHSEED pin which would mask latent non-determinism). Verified seed-robust across PYTHONHASHSEED=1/42/12345.

Required-check semantics preserved (#764): the matrix job names `test (3.11)`/`test (3.12)`/`test (3.13)` and the `coverage` job name are unchanged, so the ao-release-gate `--required-check` allowlist and the test_ao_release_gate_enforce_job invariant remain valid and were NOT modified. Top-level concurrency carves out `main` (post-merge scorecard-main baseline must complete) and all `pull_request: edited` events (a non-retarget title/body edit is skipped by event-gate, so cancelling would shadow-cancel an in-progress real required-check run).

PoC evidence (isolated /tmp venv, pytest-xdist 3.8.0 + pytest-cov 7.1.0): serial+cov 192s/6132 pass/85% -> `-n4`+cov 97s/6132 pass/85.21% (2x, coverage parity) -> `-n4` no-cov 59s (3.3x). Re-validated on rebased base @46121bb: EXACT 3.13 leg `-n auto`+cov+--cov-fail-under=85 -> exit 0, 63s, 6168 passed/86 skipped, 85.21% >= 85%, no collection divergence with the 36 tests origin/main added; sentinel simulation (coverage.data -> coverage report --fail-under=85) -> exit 0, 85%; ruff clean; 279 workflow-structure invariant tests pass.
